yaml:
version: v1alpha1
pipeline:
  name: test-pipeline
  mode: snapshot
  schedule: manual
source:
  kind: postgres
  connection:
    host: localhost
    port: 5432
    database: astra
    username: astra
    passwordRef: env:POSTGRES_PASSWORD
  capture:
    tables:
      - public.orders
    snapshot:
      mode: full
      chunkSize: 1000
destination:
  kind: postgres
  connection:
    host: localhost
    port: 5432
    database: astra
    username: astra
    passwordRef: env:POSTGRES_PASSWORD
    schema: astra_quickstart
    tablePrefix: raw_
  staging:
    kind: local
    bucket: astra-staging
    prefix: test-pipeline/
  write:
    mode: append
runtime:
  parallelism:
    tables: 1
